known_before_run: OPT-01 v1 Stage B, GRID-01, the W4 history and the retained quadratic refit are visible. Hindcast, not a precise prediction: with baseline downforce 0.2545 / 0.3316 / 0.3613 N at n = 16 / 24 / 32 and 1/n or 1/n^2 scaling of the changes, the flow_48 parent downforce is expected near 0.38-0.40 N. No prediction is registered for b_48 or a_48. FD-07 (a lattice-phase shift changed the flow_24 short-window baseline by +11.9% drag, +7.2% downforce, a re-sampling not a pure translation) is weak prior support that placement matters. The 3e-5 N floor is unmeasured on flow_16/32/48. G = b_32n - b_24n = 3.95e-4 N/mm is already known from the retained OPT-01 Stage B data (b_24n = 9.4e-5, b_32n = 4.9e-4, intercept-free fits); only b_24s, b_32s and b_48n are new. The absolute thresholds are |db| >= 1.98e-4 N/mm (0.5 G) and |db| <= 7.9e-5 N/mm (0.2 G); with these retained b values STABLE_32_TO_48 implies r in [0.63, 1.38], i.e. FINE_CONTINUES_TO_FLOW32.
prohibitions: no true-grid or physical downforce/drag claim
no gradient, optimizer or second-iteration claim
no amendment of any threshold or rule after the run, no rule change of OPT-01
no automatic repair or resubmission after an integrity failure
no claim that the shift control is a full alignment control (z unshifted)

rules.both_grid_rule: descriptive only: downforce gain > 3e-5 N and drag change <= 0 on every listed grid

decision_map.dominant: the slopes are sensitive to the (h/2, h/2, 0) shift; next = register a placement-robust evaluation (native + shifted average) before any new accept rule; no basis expansion.
decision_map.negligible_stable: flow_32 slope is within 30% of flow_48 for this response; next = proposals on flow_32 with a flow_48 finalist confirmation, and a separately registered amendment of the dual-grid rule.
decision_map.negligible_unstable: no affordable grid gives a stable sub-5 mm slope; next = larger-step / coarser-design-lattice study (solver-free preparation first).
decision_map.partial: a second placement phase study (other x/y phases, and z at a registered ride-height tolerance) before any rule change.

rules.decision_map_note: The map branches only on the alignment class and the STABLE flag; the not-stable branch merges 'still growing' and 'turning back'.
rules.descriptive_robustness: never changes the verdict: per cell b_c = (dL(+1.25 mm) - dL(-1.25 mm))/2.5, b with intercept, leave-one-out b, b_48n with all forward points against the f48a parent, and whether the alignment/fine/stable results would change if b_c / b_with_intercept / that b_48n replaced b
rules.fit: dL = b s + a s^2, s in mm, least squares on the forward points (no intercept); intercept check on forward points plus the parent point; reverse points are a check only
rules.peak: for a < 0 and b > 0: peak step b/(2|a|), attainable gain b^2/(4|a|), zero crossing b/|a|, peak within tested range iff b/(2|a|) <= 1.25 mm, in-range maximum at min(peak step, 1.25 mm); beyond the range it is an extrapolation
rules.reference: dL, dD against the SAME kernel's parent (flow_48: +1.25 mm and reverse 1.25 mm against the parent repeat of f48b)
rules.resolution: max(3e-5 N, largest observed parent-pair |difference| of downforce and drag on the grid); the floor is nominal flow_24, unmeasured elsewhere
rules.shift_integrity: the shifted flow_24 and flow_32 parents must differ from the native parents in downforce or drag, else GRID02_INCOMPLETE (shift ineffective)
